recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining documentation part of the published decision at the element definition without changing the already-correct canonical type or introducing unrelated Subscription semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-28491 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that Subscription.topic be changed from a Reference(SubscriptionTopic) to a canonical SubscriptionTopic reference, with documentation telling clients that they can search SubscriptionTopic resources and/or try to resolve the canonical and might not be able to retrieve the SubscriptionTopic directly.
initial_application: The canonical type change had already been applied historically: commit 4f3fcec039 changed the old Subscription spreadsheet from Reference(SubscriptionTopic) to canonical(SubscriptionTopic), and Jira recorded 70355f13b2 as a broader Subscription documentation/application commit. In the current refactored source, Subscription.topic already had type canonical targeting SubscriptionTopic, but the element still lacked the requested lookup/direct-retrieval note.
additional_context: Subscription and SubscriptionTopic are active resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I minutes confirmed the FHIR-28491 Persuasive vote, and the originating Zulip discussion explains that canonical Subscription.topic still permits discovery by SubscriptionTopic search while direct canonical resolution or local definition hosting may not be available. Later Subscription docs retained canonical-url wording, and general canonical-reference docs cover search/resolution, but the specific Subscription.topic element guidance was absent.
reconciliation: Added a comment to source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml on Subscription.topic explaining that clients can look for the corresponding SubscriptionTopic by searching the server's SubscriptionTopic resources, such as with the url search parameter, and/or by trying direct canonical resolution, while direct retrieval might not be supported.
source_changes: source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml: added a Subscription.topic comment describing SubscriptionTopic search and direct canonical-resolution expectations.

related_jiras.note: Later Subscription introduction cleanup retained canonical URL wording but did not add the element-specific lookup caveat addressed here.
